name: Stork
tagline: A dependable app for XMPP and Jabber chat
description:
Stork is an Android app for XMPP, also known as Jabber, one of the oldest open messaging standards still actively used today. It supports OMEMO encryption, so your conversations stay private even though the network itself is open and decentralized.

If you already have a Jabber account, or want a straightforward way to try one, Stork is a solid choice.
